about: Payload for the Figma MCP use_figma write flow (or a plugin): create collections in order, primitives first, then alias semantic variables by name. Colors are sRGB 0-1. TIMING values are seconds and EASING values are cubic-bezier or spring objects (plugin API, 5 Aug 2026, L07); if the file rejects them, use each variable's fallback. Composite tokens become text styles and effect styles (light values; bind colors to the Color collection).

variables.name: color/text/primary
variables.description: Body copy, headings, labels (guaranteed >= 7:1 on steps 1-5).

variables.name: color/text/secondary
variables.description: Supporting text (guaranteed >= the text minimum on surfaces and neutral fills 1-4).

variables.name: color/text/tertiary
variables.description: Captions and placeholders: the same grey as secondary, so text keeps three greys (primary, secondary, disabled; owner, 2026-11-05).

variables.name: color/text/disabled

variables.name: color/text/link

variables.name: color/border/default

variables.name: color/border/strong
variables.description: Boundaries that are the only cue: inputs, checkboxes, switches (3:1, WCAG 1.4.11).

variables.name: color/border/input
variables.description: Text field and select borders (3:1, DC-L01-16).

variables.name: color/border/focus
variables.description: Focus ring (3:1 against every surface, DC-L04-09).

variables.name: color/border/separator
variables.description: Hairlines between table rows and list items, lighter than border.subtle; decorative, so never the only cue (DC-L23-05).

variables.name: color/border/success
variables.description: Success boundary, for example an invalid field (3:1).

variables.name: color/border/warning

variables.name: color/icon/default
variables.description: Icons beside text; same color as secondary text (DC-L05-08).

variables.name: color/shadow/key
variables.description: Key shadow color; alpha doubles in dark (DC-L04-12).

variables.name: color/shadow/ring
variables.description: 1px ring for ring-and-shadow depth and dark overlays (#BDBDBD at 12% pattern, DC-L04-12).

variables.name: space/section/sm
variables.description: Outer gap between groups: at least ratio x the inner gap (inner < outer, L15 P16).

variables.name: space/section/md
variables.description: Outer gap between groups: at least ratio x the inner gap (inner < outer, L15 P16).

variables.name: space/section/lg
variables.description: Outer gap between groups: at least ratio x the inner gap (inner < outer, L15 P16).

variables.name: font/family/display
variables.description: Display face for headings (Apple, Google and Linear split display and text faces, DC-L06-07).

variables.name: font/family/text

variables.name: layout/container/max

variables.name: layout/measure/lead
variables.description: 52 characters per line (the lead under a heading); CSS uses ch.

variables.name: layout/measure/prose
variables.description: 65 characters per line (paragraphs); CSS uses ch.

variables.name: motion/duration/extra
variables.description: Illustrative and marketing motion only: UI animations stay under 300ms (house standard STD-easing-duration-06).

variables.name: motion/duration/long-exit
variables.description: About 0.8 x long, the entrance in force (STD-easing-duration-11).

variables.name: motion/duration/medium-exit
variables.description: About 0.8 x medium, the entrance in force (STD-easing-duration-11).

variables.name: radius/container
variables.description: Cards, panels, photos and media: one corner for all of them.

variables.name: radius/control
variables.description: Buttons and ctas, inputs, selects, chips, toggles, tabs, carousel arrows: one corner for all of them (Roundness dial or Q-shape-01, DC-L04-02).

variables.name: radius/control-sm
variables.description: Controls under 32px tall drop one step (Fluent, S-L04-007).

variables.name: radius/focus
variables.description: Focus ring radius = control radius + ring offset (Atlassian radius + 2px, S-L04-016).

variables.name: radius/nested
variables.description: Inner radius for an element inset by space.inset.lg inside a container: max(outer - padding, smallest step) (DC-L04-05).

variables.name: radius/person
variables.description: Avatars, dots and status pips only.

variables.name: size/icon/default
variables.description: Default icon size from the Density dial (DC-L05-05).

variables.name: size/target/min
variables.description: Hit-area floor for the product's primary input; grow hit areas (not visuals) to reach it.

variables.name: space/target/gap
variables.description: Gap between adjacent targets: 12 coarse, 8 fine (Primer, S-L03-009).

corners.about: Corner smoothing is a layer property in Figma, not a variable (DC-L04-04, Q-shape-04). Set cornerSmoothing to this value on every frame and component that has a radius: 0.6 is Figma's iOS preset for continuous corners, 0 is a plain circular arc. Capsules and circles keep 0.
